chapters.summary: Jude urges believers to earnestly contend for the faith, warning them to stay alert to and steer clear of the corrupt conduct of false teachers.
keyPoints: Reminds believers to earnestly contend for the faith once for all delivered to the saints.

Exposes the ungodliness and corruption of false teachers, warning through historical examples: Israel destroyed in the wilderness for unbelief, the angels who left their proper place, and Sodom and Gomorrah.
Encourages believers to build themselves up in their most holy faith and to keep themselves in the love of God.
chapters.application: In your own walk of faith today, hold fast to the truth once for all entrusted to the saints, stay alert to the lure of false teaching, support and encourage one another in love, keep a reverent heart, and live a holy life.
